A be boli pɔmpi bɛɛ kan ani a mako be ɛntɛrɛnɛti la (miniti 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox ka bɔ réseau kɔnɔ: a be keybox dɔ ta ka bɔ ofisiyɛli marayɔrɔ la (GitHub) k’a mara /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. A mako be ɛntɛrɛnɛti la ani a be miniti 1-3 ta. A be baara kɛ n’a ka smart fetch ma se ka baara kɛ wala n’a ka keybox yɛlɛmana bolo la.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP sɛgɛsɛgɛri: a be modɛliw sɛgɛsɛgɛ minw be sɔrɔ yɔrɔjan na, a be TEE seereyasɛbɛn yɛlɛmani sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani a be KmInstallKeybox ka baarakɛminanw cogoya yira. A tɛ foyi yɛlɛma — a be minanw ka cogoya yira cogo nɔgɔman na.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine sɛgɛsɛgɛri (kalan dɔrɔn): a be Widevine nivo yiracogow yira (L1/L3) ka bɔ dumpsys la, DRM (IDM) ka kilɛ-fayili sɔrɔli, ani sisitɛmu ka jogow minw be taga n’o ye. A tɛ foyi yɛlɛma fewu.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Gafe RKP labɛn: a be sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh gafe boli. A be seereyako gwɛlɛyaw labɛn ni passe automatique ma se ka kɛ. Boli kelen kelen bɛɛ be ɲɛtaga/dɛsɛ yɔrɔ dɔ sɛbɛ ka gwɛ.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Dafalen RKP labɛn: boli sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh dafanin. A be koo gwɛlɛw ɲɛnabɔ ani a be wagati caaman ta. Jaabi gwɛnin dɔ be bɔ a laban na.
strings.mdGmsReset: • GMS labɛn kokura: Play Store ani Google baarakɛyɔrɔw (GMS+GSF) ka kunnafoniw jɔɔsi ani ka minan lawuli tugun a yɛrɛ ma. Ka seereya kɛ ni tulonkɛfɛnw dɔrɔn ye — a t’i bolo maga i ka fotow wala i ka dosiyew la abada.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: a be RKP ka seereyali cogoya sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani a be seereyali cogoyaw labɛn kokura n’a mako be o la. A tɛ maga baarakɛlaw ka kunnafoniw na.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER dilan: a be Google baarakɛcogo (SOTER) ka koow labɛn minw ɲɛsinna minanw ka seereya ma. A be baara kɛ ni minan dɔw ye minw be basigi SOTER kan sanni ka basigi Play Integrity kan.
strings.mdPifApply: • A’ ye PIF: boli sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh fanga la. A be bololafɛn sugandinin (yɔrɔ/ɲɛtaga) baara ani ka pif.prop/pif.json ka sɛbɛw lakuraya. Jaabi gwɛnin dɔ be bɔ lɔgɔ kɔnɔ.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF sɛgɛsɛgɛri: a be motɛri siginin cogoya yira, bolonɔw (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop) ani lɔgɔw. A sɛgɛsɛgɛ dɔrɔn — a tɛ foyi yɛlɛma.
strings.mdCanary: • Kanari yɛlɛmani: boli sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. A be Canary Engine bɔko laban ta walisa k’a lɔn n’a be bɛn ni RKP sɛbɛw ye minw ka ɲi ka kɛ (saan 2026, feburukalo).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Motɛri sɛgɛsɛgɛri: a be TrickyStoreOSS cogoya sɛgɛsɛgɛ (pid, logs), nɛgɛjuruw ka dosiyew (active vs utilisateur), minɛn yɛrɛ yɛrɛ vs nɛgɛrifɛnw bolonɔ, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP nɛgɛjuruw. Bana sɛgɛsɛgɛri yiracogo dɔrɔn lo.
